sources.name: Bengaluru Mobility Indicators (zone population, jobs, trip rate, mode share)
IRC:106-1990 Guidelines for Capacity of Urban Roads in Plain Areas
Comprehensive Traffic & Transportation Plan for Bangalore (RITES), Ch. 3
BBMP ward-wise data (2011 census population, 198 wards, with zone)
ADB / Asian Transport Observatory, Bengaluru Urban Transport - State of Play (CMP 2020 trip lengths by mode)
ICRA, Commercial Real Estate - Office - Bengaluru (Grade-A stock, occupancy, regional split)

peakHourFactor.basis: Share of daily trips in the peak hour; Indian metro planning range 8-11% (CTTP/CMP practice).

peakDirectionShare.basis: 60:40 directional split in the peak hour (standard design practice); peak-direction lanes carry 60% of flow on 50% of lanes.

majorRoadVehicleKmShare.basis: Share of peak vehicle-km carried on the arterial / sub-arterial / expressway network; collectors and local streets carry the access legs of trips.

freeFlowSpeedKmph.basis: Free-flow speed on urban arterials (IRC:106 design speeds 50-60 km/h, reduced for signal density).

bprBeta.basis: Delay-curve exponent for signal-controlled urban networks, where delay grows closer to linearly with load than on uninterrupted highways (the original BPR value of 4).

peakWorkTripShare.basis: Share of peak-hour trips going to a workplace; the rest (school, errands) are attracted in proportion to population.

routeCircuity.basis: Road distance / straight-line distance between zone centres (typical urban value 1.2-1.4).

busPeakSpeedKmph.basis: CMP 2020 observed public-transport peak journey speed (measured value reused as bus operating speed).

transitServiceElasticity.basis: Ridership elasticity to service frequency of about +0.5 (TCRP Report 95, Ch. 9).

payloadTonnes.basis: Typical rated payloads for Indian LCV, 2-axle truck and multi-axle vehicle.

loadFactor.basis: Average laden share of goods-vehicle capacity including empty backhauls.

freightFleetUtilisation.basis: Freight fleet sized to run at 75% utilisation under city-average baseline congestion (no public fleet-capacity data).

travelShareOfCycleTime.basis: Half of a delivery / waste-collection cycle is driving; the rest is loading, unloading and handling. Congestion scales only the driving half.

wasteProcessingCapacityTpd.basis: BBMP operational processing plants ('old sites') per BBMP plant list; 2,300 TPD of listed new sites excluded as commissioning status is unverified.

overallWeights.basis: Composite index weights; policy choice, not data. The three indices are also shown separately.

sqftPerOfficeSeat.basis: Gross leasable area per office seat; Indian Grade-A benchmark 100-125 sq ft.

officeClusterSplit.basis: Split of ICRA's 263 msf across 15 named clusters. Region totals match ICRA (86% north-east + south-east; ORR, Whitefield and Nagavara ~36%); the split within a region is estimated. Clusters outside BBMP go to the nearest zone, whose roads carry their commute.

metroServiceElasticity.basis: Ridership elasticity to metro service (frequency / coverage); same TCRP Report 95 value as bus.

closureDiversionShare.basis: Share of a closed corridor's displaced peak traffic that reroutes through neighbouring zones; the rest diverts to parallel roads inside the zone.

offPeakTravelTimeIndex.basis: Travel-time index for night / off-peak runs (near free flow, with signal delay).

calibration.method: alpha solved by the engine so the demand-weighted mean zone travel-time index equals free-flow speed / CMP 2020 observed peak speed (40 / 11 km/h).
